data.notes: As of May 2026, September’s confirmed music calendar around Hvar is still sparse, with the strongest verified listing a local folklore song-and-dance showcase in Jelsa on Hvar Island.

events.title: Island Folklore Groups on Show
events.summary: A cultural gathering of folklore ensembles from Croatian islands, presenting traditional heritage through dance, song, and costumes. The event is organized by KUD Jelsa and the Jelsa Municipality Tourist Board, with a listed start time of 21:00.
